fact: At the 2nd Symposium international sur l'état civil des pays d'Afrique francophone in Abidjan, 10 to 12 December 2024, the Central African Republic's representative, Jean-Symphorien Ngama-Piault, said the country was starting a digitalisation process supported by the European Union that was still at the pilot phase and was due to extend to 40 localities in 2025; the article names no pilot centres and does not say which events are entered.
title: Digitalisation de l’état civil : L’expérience du Burkina Faso, de la Centrafrique et du Congo
